//: Template for the real appsettings.json, which is gitignored because it holds the local Production connection string. Copy this file to appsettings.json in the project root before the first run on a new machine. A fresh clone has no appsettings.json at all, and startup fails in DataEnvironmentResolver with 'Expected database name for Production is not configured.'
//split: Non-secret deployment endpoints (the Demo database name and API address) live in appsettings.Public.json, which IS tracked. Only the Production half belongs here.
//ConnectionStrings: DataEnvironmentResolver reads the connection string named SatiProduction and cross-checks its Initial Catalog against DataEnvironments:Production:ExpectedDatabaseName. The two must name the same database or startup refuses.
//database: SatiProduction must exist and carry the dbo.SatiDatabaseIdentity marker BEFORE first run: DatabaseIdentityValidator runs ahead of Database.Migrate(), so pointing at an empty database fails closed rather than building one. Create the local environments with scripts/Provision-LocalDataEnvironments.ps1.
//LocalAi: Local case-note drafting. Enabled=false removes the feature from the note-entry UI without touching XAML or DI. The first drafting request downloads the ModelAlias variant (multi-gigabyte) into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Sati\LocalAi.
